mapper.select: SELECT model_version FROM rec_model_version WHERE domain = #{domain} AND status = 'active' ORDER BY COALESCE(activated_at, trained_at, created_at) DESC LIMIT 1

choose.when: SELECT 'huagao' AS domain, h.id AS id, h.id AS itemId, h.name AS name, h.name AS title, h.photo AS photo, h.price AS price, h.fenlei AS fenlei, h.fenlei AS category, h.content AS content, h.type AS type, h.status AS status, h.shangjiaids AS shangjiaids, h.shangjiaids AS authorId, COALESCE(u.name, u.username) AS artistName, COALESCE(u.name, u.username) AS authorName, h.zhekou AS zhekou, h.fujin AS fujin, r.score AS recScore, r.reason AS recReason FROM rec_user_recommendation r INNER JOIN sys_huagao h ON h.id = r.item_id LEFT JOIN x_user u ON u.id = CAST(h.shangjiaids AS UNSIGNED) WHERE r.domain = #{domain} AND r.model_version = #{modelVersion} AND r.actor_key = #{actorKey} AND h.status = '审核成功' AND h.type = '上架' ORDER BY r.rank_no ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT 'zuopin' AS domain, z.id AS id, z.id AS itemId, z.title AS title, z.title AS name, z.photo AS photo, NULL AS price, z.fenlei AS fenlei, z.fenlei AS category, z.content AS content, z.userids AS userids, z.userids AS authorId, z.username AS username, z.username AS authorName, z.dznum AS dznum, DATE_FORMAT(z.fbdate, '%Y-%m-%d') AS fbdate, r.score AS recScore, r.reason AS recReason FROM rec_user_recommendation r INNER JOIN sys_zuopin z ON z.id = r.item_id WHERE r.domain = #{domain} AND r.model_version = #{modelVersion} AND r.actor_key = #{actorKey} ORDER BY r.rank_no ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT 'project' AS domain, p.id AS id, p.id AS itemId, p.title AS title, p.title AS name, NULL AS photo, p.description AS description, p.category AS category, p.category AS fenlei, p.style AS style, p.budget_min AS budgetMin, p.budget_max AS budgetMax, DATE_FORMAT(p.deadline, '%Y-%m-%d') AS deadline, p.status AS status, p.user_id AS userId, p.user_id AS authorId, p.username AS username, p.username AS authorName, p.user_avatar AS userAvatar, r.score AS recScore, r.reason AS recReason FROM rec_user_recommendation r INNER JOIN sys_project p ON p.id = r.item_id WHERE r.domain = #{domain} AND r.model_version = #{modelVersion} AND r.actor_key = #{actorKey} AND p.status = '招募中' ORDER BY r.rank_no ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
choose.otherwise: SELECT 'artist' AS domain, u.id AS id, u.id AS itemId, u.id AS authorId, u.username AS username, COALESCE(u.name, u.username) AS name, u.avatar AS avatar, u.status AS status, u.bio AS bio, u.style_tags AS styleTags, COUNT(DISTINCT h.id) AS workCount, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT h.photo ORDER BY h.id DESC SEPARATOR '|||') AS recentCovers, r.score AS recScore, r.reason AS recReason FROM rec_user_recommendation r INNER JOIN x_user u ON u.id = r.item_id LEFT JOIN sys_huagao h ON h.shangjiaids = CAST(u.id AS CHAR) AND h.type = '上架' AND h.status = '审核成功' WHERE r.domain = #{domain} AND r.model_version = #{modelVersion} AND r.actor_key = #{actorKey} AND u.status = 1 AND COALESCE(u.deleted, 0) = 0 GROUP BY u.id, u.username, u.name, u.avatar, u.status, u.bio, u.style_tags, r.score, r.reason, r.rank_no ORDER BY r.rank_no ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

choose.when: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_huagao WHERE status = '审核成功' AND type = '上架'
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM sys_project WHERE status = '招募中'
choose.otherwise: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT u.id) FROM x_user u INNER JOIN x_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id INNER JOIN x_role r ON r.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE u.status = 1 AND COALESCE(u.deleted, 0) = 0 AND r.role_name = '画师角色'

choose.when: SELECT 'huagao' AS domain, h.id AS id, h.id AS itemId, h.name AS name, h.name AS title, h.photo AS photo, h.price AS price, h.fenlei AS fenlei, h.fenlei AS category, h.content AS content, h.type AS type, h.status AS status, h.shangjiaids AS shangjiaids, h.shangjiaids AS authorId, COALESCE(u.name, u.username) AS artistName, COALESCE(u.name, u.username) AS authorName, h.zhekou AS zhekou, h.fujin AS fujin FROM sys_huagao h LEFT JOIN x_user u ON u.id = CAST(h.shangjiaids AS UNSIGNED) WHERE h.status = '审核成功' AND h.type = '上架' ORDER BY h.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT 'zuopin' AS domain, z.id AS id, z.id AS itemId, z.title AS title, z.title AS name, z.photo AS photo, NULL AS price, z.fenlei AS fenlei, z.fenlei AS category, z.content AS content, z.userids AS userids, z.userids AS authorId, z.username AS username, z.username AS authorName, z.dznum AS dznum, DATE_FORMAT(z.fbdate, '%Y-%m-%d') AS fbdate FROM sys_zuopin z ORDER BY z.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT 'project' AS domain, p.id AS id, p.id AS itemId, p.title AS title, p.title AS name, NULL AS photo, p.description AS description, p.category AS category, p.category AS fenlei, p.style AS style, p.budget_min AS budgetMin, p.budget_max AS budgetMax, DATE_FORMAT(p.deadline, '%Y-%m-%d') AS deadline, p.status AS status, p.user_id AS userId, p.user_id AS authorId, p.username AS username, p.username AS authorName, p.user_avatar AS userAvatar FROM sys_project p WHERE p.status = '招募中' ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
choose.otherwise: SELECT 'artist' AS domain, u.id AS id, u.id AS itemId, u.id AS authorId, u.username AS username, COALESCE(u.name, u.username) AS name, u.avatar AS avatar, u.status AS status, u.bio AS bio, u.style_tags AS styleTags, COUNT(DISTINCT h.id) AS workCount, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT h.photo ORDER BY h.id DESC SEPARATOR '|||') AS recentCovers FROM x_user u INNER JOIN x_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id INNER JOIN x_role r ON r.role_id = ur.role_id LEFT JOIN sys_huagao h ON h.shangjiaids = CAST(u.id AS CHAR) AND h.type = '上架' AND h.status = '审核成功' WHERE u.status = 1 AND COALESCE(u.deleted, 0) = 0 AND r.role_name = '画师角色' GROUP BY u.id, u.username, u.name, u.avatar, u.status, u.bio, u.style_tags ORDER BY u.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
